name: paper-grid-explainer
summary_ar: شرح بالموشن جرافيك: خلفية ورق مربعات فاتحة، كلمات مهمة داخل مربعات خضراء، بطاقات داكنة، أيقونات بسيطة تُبنى تدريجياً، شريط تقدّم عمودي يسار، واسم الفصل في الأسفل. بدون قص حاد.

captions.highlight_rule: one to three key words per caption (the noun/verb that carries the meaning) sit in mint boxes; the rest stays plain dark text
captions.enter: each word pops in 120ms, slight scale 0.9→1
captions.exit: fade 150ms as the next caption starts; the next caption may appear faded for 2–3 frames before

rhythm.scene_build: incremental: each chapter keeps one central illustration that gains elements as the VO mentions them

frame.progress_bar: left-vertical line x=42px from y=520 to y=1460, mint filled part grows with time, ring dot at the head
frame.chapter_pill: bottom-center dark pill (card_dark) with white Arabic label, y≈1540

scene_patterns: metric card: white card with bars rising (views, growth)
player card: dark rounded rectangle with play icon and a mint progress line + numbered steps 1-2-3
app card: white window with tabs (Chat / Code) and a logo
folder: mint folder icon, files flying in
prompt card: dark card with mint 'برومبت' chip and grey text lines
hub: a central mark with spokes to tool tiles (white rounded squares with a letter + label) and a counter n/N
phones fan: 3-4 dark phone cards with play icons, one highlighted
edit bubble: white chip 'غيّر هذا الجزء' + dark button 'تم التعديل' + before/after cards
CTA: big white card with the comment keyword

icons.style: flat, rounded corners, two-tone green; letters inside tiles instead of third-party logos unless the user supplies them in assets/

audio.music: low, soft bed under VO (-22 LUFS relative)
audio.sfx: soft pop on each caption, whoosh on chapter change
